# PriceSignal brief
> same as last time, but what if we only go +3%?

**+3% is above the market benchmark in DE; within the market benchmark in CA and AU.**

Cost policy: recover 70% of incremental unit cost (remembered from an earlier request (mem-1)) · proposed change: +3%. This policy does not scale the market benchmark.

The historical market benchmark spans the latest YoY rate and the mean of available observations in the year ending at the latest observation. It is not a forecast, a confidence interval or evidence that customers will accept a price change. A single value is a reference point, not a recommended price.

| Market | Official category | Latest period | YoY | Available-year average | Trend vs. 6 months ago | All-items YoY | Market benchmark | Proposed change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DE (Eurostat (HICP)) | Food and non-alcoholic beverages | 2026-09 | +0.4% | +1.4% (12 of 12 monthly observations) | easing | +3.3% (All-items context only; 2026-09) | 0.4–1.4% | above the market benchmark |
| CA (Statistics Canada (CPI)) | Food | 2026-09 | +2.2% | +4.1% (12 of 12 monthly observations) | easing | +3.1% (All-items context only; 2026-09) | 2.2–4.1% | within the market benchmark |
| AU (Australian Bureau of Statistics (CPI)) | Food and non-alcoholic beverages | 2026-08 | +3.0% | +3.2% (12 of 12 monthly observations) | flat | +4.0% (All-items context only; 2026-08) | 3.0–3.2% | within the market benchmark |

Every rate above comes from Zetaris query **Q11** (one federated SQL over the onboarded sources); market benchmarks and comparisons are computed in code from those rates.

## Same-period comparison

Latest common observation: **2026-08** (monthly; 2 months before this brief). Only observation dates are aligned. National baskets and category coverage can still differ, so equal dates do not make these series identical measures.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| DE | Food and non-alcoholic beverages | +0.2% | 2026-09: +0.4% | eurostat:prc_hicp_minr:CP01:RCH_A · Q11 |

| AU | Food and non-alcoholic beverages | +3.0% | 2026-08: +3.0% | abs:CPI:1.20001.10.50.M · Q11 |

The latest-period market benchmarks and SKU price scenarios remain unchanged. This table aligns observation dates only.
